stories.headline: Jim Keller's Tenstorrent raises $1.5B Series E at $6.2B valuation to scale Galaxy servers

key_facts.fact: Tenstorrent closed a $1.5B Series E at a $6.2B post-money valuation, announced October 19, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Tenstorrent, the AI computing company, has closed $1.5B in Series E funding at a $6.2B post-money valuation.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from ARK Invest, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley, Sandisk, T. Rowe Price, Tether Investments, XTX Markets, Cadence Ventures and others.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from new and existing investors including Agostinelli Group, ARK Invest, Brett Barna, Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Maverick Silicon, Morgan Stanley, Protagonist, Sandisk, T. Rowe Price*, Tether Investments, Troluce Capital, Virtu Financial, and XTX Markets.

key_facts.fact: The valuation more than doubles the December 2024 round, which raised more than $693M at a $2B pre-money valuation led by Samsung Securities and AFW Partners.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup's last funding round raised more than $693 million in December 2024 at a $2 billion pre-money valuation, with Samsung Securities and AFW Partners leading the financing.

key_facts.fact: The money will fund deployment of Galaxy servers at scale and development of the AI and RISC-V CPU IP it licenses to chip designers such as Samsung and LG.
key_facts.excerpt: Tenstorrent will use the capital to deploy Galaxy servers at scale, continuing to serve open-weight models across LLMs and video generation, and advance the AI and CPU IP it licenses to customers designing their own silicon.

key_facts.fact: Tenstorrent builds AI chips on the open-source RISC-V architecture; its Galaxy servers combine dozens of its chips to run chatbots, coding assistants and video generators.
key_facts.excerpt: scale production of its Galaxy servers, which combine dozens of its AI chips to power applications including chatbots, coding assistants and video generators. Tenstorrent develops AI chips and software using RISC-V, an open-source chip architecture

key_facts.fact: CEO Jim Keller, architect of Apple A4/A5, AMD Zen and Tesla's self-driving chip, said: 'We built one architecture and sell it at every size.'
key_facts.excerpt: "We built one architecture and sell it at every size," said Jim Keller, CEO of Tenstorrent. "The future of compute is open, scalable, and owned by the people building on it."

key_facts.fact: Tenstorrent had attracted takeover interest earlier in 2026, according to Bloomberg.
key_facts.excerpt: AI chip startup Tenstorrent Inc., after attracting takeover interest earlier this year, has raised $1.5 billion from investors

stories.headline: Samsung to make Nvidia's custom HBM base dies on rival TSMC's 3nm process, report says

key_facts.fact: Samsung will build the base die for Nvidia's custom high-bandwidth memory (NVHBM) on TSMC's 3nm process, Seoul Economic Daily reported October 18 citing industry sources; it would be Samsung's first collaboration with TSMC at the HBM manufacturing stage.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung will make the base dies for NVIDIA's custom high-bandwidth memory (HBM) on TSMC's 3nm process, Seoul Economic Daily reports, citing industry sources. It would be the first time Samsung has teamed up with TSMC at the HBM manufacturing stage.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia asked all three HBM suppliers, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron, to use TSMC 3nm for NVHBM base dies and sixth-generation (1c) DRAM for the core dies, so memory performs consistently across suppliers.
key_facts.excerpt: It asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to build NVHBM base dies on TSMC's 3nm and to standardize the DRAM layers above on the sixth-generation process, 1c.

key_facts.fact: NVHBM moves the memory controller from the GPU onto the base die; Nvidia claims up to 30% more bandwidth and 15% lower power than standard HBM4E, with the physical layer shrunk 60%.
key_facts.excerpt: The redesign lets NVHBM widen memory bandwidth by up to 30% and cut power use by 15% against standard HBM4E, the seventh generation. To fit the controller, the physical layer was shrunk by 60%.

key_facts.fact: Industry estimates put TSMC 3nm yield above 90% versus around 60% for Samsung Foundry's comparable 2nm (SF2) process.
key_facts.excerpt: 업계에서는 TSMC 3나노의 수율을 90% 이상으로, 이에 대응하는 삼성 파운드리 2나노(SF2) 공정은 60% 안팎으로 보고 있다.

key_facts.fact: UBS projects 2027 HBM demand at about 61.5 billion gigabits (up 91%) versus new shipments of 54.6 billion gigabits, a roughly 10% shortfall.
key_facts.excerpt: 투자은행 UBS에 따르면 내년 HBM 수요는 비트(저장용량 단위) 기준 약 615억 Gb(기가비트)로 올해보다 91% 늘어날 것으로 전망된다. 반면 메모리 업체들의 신규 출하량은 546억 Gb에 그칠 것으로 예상돼 수요 대비 10%가량 공급 부족이 우려되는 상황이다.

key_facts.fact: Samsung keeps in-house production for standard HBM and custom HBM for other customers such as AMD, and is evaluating whether its own foundry could make NVHBM base dies if demand outgrows TSMC capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: The in-house model stays for standard HBM and for custom HBM for other customers, including AMD. Samsung is also checking whether its own foundry can make NVHBM base dies

key_facts.fact: The report rests on unnamed industry sources, not company statements, and names no chip, start date or volume.
key_facts.excerpt: The report rests on unnamed industry sources, not the companies, and names no chip, start date or volume.

stories.headline: Nscale faces pushback on ~$30B IPO valuation as Microsoft exits its UK data center deal

key_facts.fact: Some prospective investors are pushing Nvidia-backed neocloud Nscale to accept a $16B-$19B valuation instead of the roughly $30B it is targeting for its NYSE IPO, Bloomberg reported October 18.
key_facts.excerpt: A group of investors has argued for a valuation of $16 billion to $19 billion instead, according to Bloomberg. Among the factors they cited was the unraveling of a planned IPO by Firmus

key_facts.fact: Microsoft, Nscale's anchor tenant, pulled out of the Loughton, Essex data center deal after UK Power Networks told Nscale the site would not get enough grid power until the early 2030s.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft has pulled out of a data centre agreement in Essex with Nscale... Nscale was notified by UK Power Networks that it would not gain access to enough grid power until the early 2030s.

key_facts.fact: Nscale said it remains committed to Loughton, is exploring alternative power sources, and that the grid issue has no impact on its other Microsoft contracts.
key_facts.excerpt: "We remain committed to both the Loughton project and the UK and we are exploring alternative power sources for the site... Our relationship with Microsoft remains strong and long-term, and this unfortunate London-wide grid issue has no impact on our other contracts."

key_facts.fact: Nscale reported $103.4B of active and contracted total contract value as of August 31, including up to about $44.6B from Anthropic agreements; for the six months to June 30 it had revenue of $140.6M and a net loss of $1.02B.
key_facts.excerpt: the company said it had $103.4 billion of active and contracted total contract value as of Aug. 31. That includes agreements with Anthropic that provide for payments of up to about $44.6 billion. Nscale reported revenue of $140.6 million and a net loss of $1.02 billion for the six months ended June 30.

key_facts.fact: Construction at Nscale's flagship Norway facility is running six months late, and formal IPO marketing remains on hold while it addresses SEC feedback.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg separately reported that construction at Nscale's flagship Norway facility is running six months late... Formal marketing remains on hold

key_facts.fact: Peer stocks have slumped: CoreWeave lost 25% last week and Nebius is down 32% in two weeks amid higher borrowing costs for AI infrastructure firms.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave stock shed 25% of its value last week, and Nebius stock has declined 32% in the last two weeks.

stories.headline: China proposes export bans and curbs on 40 technologies spanning AI, chip design and solar

key_facts.fact: On October 16, China's Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology published a draft revision of the catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export, adding 40 technologies in AI, biomedicine and photovoltaics.
key_facts.excerpt: 此次公开征求意见涉及人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域40项技术。人工智能领域包括大模型、智能体、算力集群、信息处理相关23项技术

key_facts.fact: 14 technologies would be banned from export and 26 restricted; the 23 AI items cover large models, agents, computing clusters and information processing, including AI chip design, while technologies already open-sourced or published are excluded.
key_facts.excerpt: banning 14 and restricting 26... They include technologies for using AI to generate and modify malicious code, AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, core LLM technologies, and AI chip design. Technologies already in the public domain through open-source releases, academic papers, or other means would be excluded.

key_facts.fact: Automatic licensing would apply to cases such as Chinese firms running their own overseas data centers and chip tape-out and fabrication conducted abroad; offering model access via API, apps or SaaS falls outside the controls.
key_facts.excerpt: Facilitation measures, including automatic licensing, could apply to open-source tech exports, Chinese firms setting up and running their own overseas data centers, chip tape-out and fabrication conducted abroad... Providing access through application programming interface calls, apps, website interactions, and software-as-a-service applications... would fall outside the scope

key_facts.fact: Exporters must register listed technologies before export starting October 16, with public comments open until November 15.
key_facts.excerpt: 公众可在2026年10月16日-11月15日期间... 自本公告发布之日起... 技术出口经营者在出口本公告附件所列技术前，应当在商务部业务系统统一平台技术贸易管理信息应用登记。

key_facts.fact: A commerce ministry spokesperson called the move 'necessary' and cited national security; AP noted the technology race with the US is intensifying.
key_facts.excerpt: A spokesperson from the commerce ministry said in a statement that the move was "necessary" and cited national security as one of the reasons.

key_facts.fact: Separately, Taiwan's Economic Affairs Minister Kung Ming-hsin told Bloomberg (published October 16) that Taiwan will add AI servers and cutting-edge chips to its export control list, making unlicensed shipments to China a crime under the Foreign Trade Act, without giving a start date.
key_facts.excerpt: Taipei plans to add artificial intelligence servers and cutting-edge semiconductors to a list of controlled items, Taiwan's Minister of Economic Affairs Kung Ming-hsin told Bloomberg News. After the measures take effect, he said, shipping restricted AI hardware to China will become a criminal offense under the Foreign Trade Act.

key_facts.fact: Violations under Taiwan's Foreign Trade Act can carry up to five years in prison and/or a fine of around $92,500.
key_facts.excerpt: anyone caught smuggling these items will be criminally charged under the Foreign Trade Act, which carries a penalty of up to five years in prison and/or a fine of around $92,500.

stories.headline: NiSource signs 20-year, 1,100 MW power deal for Microsoft's Indiana data center campus

key_facts.fact: NiSource announced on October 16 a 20-year energy agreement with Microsoft adding about 1,100 MW of new generation resources for Microsoft's northwest Indiana campus, with service starting in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Approximately 1,100 MW of new generation resources under a 20-year agreement beginning in 2028

key_facts.fact: Microsoft fully funds all generation and transmission needed to serve its load, through NiSource's GenCo subsidiary, a structure meant to shield existing NIPSCO customers from the costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft fully funds all generation and transmission required to serve its load.

key_facts.fact: Expected savings for existing NIPSCO customers rise to about $1.75B over the life of data center contracts, up from $1.4B, or as much as $140 per customer annually.
key_facts.excerpt: increasing total expected NIPSCO electric customer savings to approximately $1.75 billion, equating to as much as $140 per customer annually.

key_facts.fact: In connection with the deal, GenCo contracted 600 MW of battery storage under a long-term tolling agreement, to be built by an affiliate of Singapore-based AGP Group.
key_facts.excerpt: GenCo has contracted 600 megawatts of battery storage, which will be developed and constructed by an affiliate of Singapore-based AGP Group.

key_facts.fact: The power serves Microsoft's $1 billion data center campus in La Porte, Indiana.
key_facts.excerpt: Merrillville-based NiSource Inc. has signed a long-term energy agreement with Microsoft for the tech giant's $1 billion data center campus in La Porte

stories.headline: Chinese physical-AI chip startup XHEART draws Renault, Chery and CXMT in strategic round

key_facts.fact: XHEART, a Chinese startup designing compute chips for autonomous driving and robots, closed a strategic round reported October 16, bringing its cumulative funding to about 5 billion yuan (roughly $700M).
key_facts.excerpt: 10月16日，第一财经记者获悉，新芯航途（XHEART）近日完成战略轮融资，历史累计融资额约50亿元人民币。

key_facts.fact: Renault Group invested for the first time, Chery added to its stake, and Chinese memory maker CXMT (Changxin) also participated.
key_facts.excerpt: 欧洲头部车企雷诺集团在本轮融资中首次投资该公司，奇瑞汽车追加投资，国产存储龙头企业长鑫科技亦参与其中。

key_facts.fact: Its X7 chip targets L2++ urban assisted driving and L3/L4 autonomy, debuting in the SAIC Volkswagen ID.ERA 9X with MG, Roewe, Cadillac and Chery models to follow.
key_facts.excerpt: Its core product, the X7, targets L2++ urban assisted driving and the L3/L4 autonomous market... The X7 debuted on SAIC Volkswagen's ID.ERA 9X and has since reached SAIC's MG and Roewe models, GM's Cadillac models, and several Chery vehicles.

key_facts.fact: XHEART was incubated by Momenta's chip team; a Momenta-linked partnership holds the largest block of shares, and the round size and valuation were not disclosed.
key_facts.excerpt: According to OFweek, Momenta's chip team incubated it... It gives no size or valuation for this one. The stakes buy these companies a place in the queue for chips, not control, because a Momenta linked partnership holds the largest block.

stories.headline: Foxconn to buy 50% of Mitsubishi Electric's auto-parts unit for ¥115B ($727M)

key_facts.fact: On October 16, Hon Hai (Foxconn) subsidiary Lin Yin International Investment and Mitsubishi Electric signed a final agreement for Lin Yin to buy 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility for an expected ¥115 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Mitsubishi Electric will transfer to Lin Yin 50% of its stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility Co., Ltd... The share transfer price is expected to be JPY 115.0 billion.

key_facts.fact: The deal sets an enterprise value of ¥320 billion and equity value of ¥230 billion for the unit, and is expected to close October 1, 2027, pending antitrust approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The share transfer agreement establishes an enterprise value of JPY 320.0 billion and an equity value of 230.0 billion for the target business... the share transfer is expected to be completed on October 1, 2027.

key_facts.fact: Mitsubishi will contribute electric powertrain, autonomous-driving and in-car intelligence technology for Foxconn's EV platforms; the partners aim to grow the unit to over ¥1 trillion in sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co is paying ¥115 billion (US$727 million) for a 50% stake in Mitsubishi Electric Corp's automotive-components unit, with the goal of turning it into a business with more than ¥1 trillion in sales.

key_facts.fact: The unit had ¥876 billion in revenue and ¥54 billion in operating profit in the year to March; Mitsubishi Electric expects a roughly ¥100 billion impairment this fiscal year.
key_facts.excerpt: The unit generated ¥876 billion in revenue and ¥54 billion in operating profit in the year ended March. Mitsubishi Electric expects to book an impairment charge of about ¥100 billion this fiscal year
